findings.exact_text: Lines 27–29 give the six permutation-to-shape map; line 45 spells out the six insertion tableaux as prose row lists.
findings.observation: The example is specifically a worked Robinson–Schensted insertion computation, but the complete body contains no tableau drawing. The insertion/recording tableaux are central objects and the current row-list prose makes the six outcomes harder to compare.
findings.concrete_diagram: A compact six-row tableau display showing each word and its (P,Q) pair. Exact maps: 123→([123],[123]); 132→([12/3],[12/3]); 213→([13/2],[13/2]); 231→([13/2],[12/3]); 312→([12/3],[13/2]); 321→([1/2/3],[1/2/3]), where slash separates tableau rows. The row shapes then visibly yield frequencies 1,4,1 for (3),(2,1),(1^3).
findings.rationale: This makes the main algorithmic object explicit and cross-checks the shape-frequency statement already given at lines 28–29; it is a focused visual aid for this concrete RSK example.
